Daily Devotional

July 18

14 For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him. 15 For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep. 16 For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first: 17 Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord. (1 Thessalonians 4:14-17 KJV)

This verse is our assurance that the souls of those Christians that have died, before the return of Jesus, will for sure return with Him when He comes. Jesus will come, to get God’s children, in what they call the rapture of the Church (Revelation 14:14-16), but the term rapture does not appear in the Bible, but rather the reaping, or harvest, of the church. This gathering of the church will happen just before the wrath of God is poured out on the earth (Revelation 16). We do know that when Jesus does come again, the dead in Christ will rise first to meet Him in the air, and then the ones still alive will be quickly changed (1 Corinthians 15:52), and all will get their glorified bodies and will live forever with the Lord.

Before the first coming of the Lord to gather His bride, the Holy Spirit will be removed from the earth, allowing the beast and antichrist to start their three and one-half years of rule (Revelation 13:5) before Jesus returns to rule for one thousand years (Revelation 20:4). For a complete sequence of events of the end times, see our “New Revelations” page on our web site. Whatever happens, we know as Christians, that we will be changed and spend eternity with the Lord (Revelation 21:3), and that is what matters. Thank God for our salvation.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
